thread:
elaine: Quick decision needed for API key revoke UX. Options: immediate hard delete, soft revoke + 7d auto-delete, soft revoke + manual delete. Thoughts?

mike: soft revoke + 7d auto-delete + undo toast. Safer for users.

jess: agree. Need clear modal copy, show last-used + scopes, and show exact deletion date.

tamir: accessibility: visually emphasize Revoke, but on open set keyboard focus to Cancel to avoid accidental activation. Announce consequences to SR.

elaine: draft copy (short): "Revoke API key? This key will stop working immediately. You can restore it within 7 days from Settings › API keys."

elaine: draft copy (expanded): "Revoke API key
Revoking will suspend this key immediately. Calls with this key will fail. The key will be permanently deleted after 7 days (MM/DD). Restore it from Settings › API keys during the window."

mike: prefer expanded for clarity.

jess: include last-used row and scopes list in the modal UI. Also put delete date (MM/DD) inline.

tamir: accessibility snippet for eng: role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby -> title, aria-describedby -> consequence. Focus move: cancelButton.focus() on open. Use aria-live="polite" for undo toast.

mike: toast copy: "API key revoked — Undo" (button: Undo). Keep toast non-focus-stealing and visible for 7s. Undo restores and writes audit log.

elaine: keyboard rules: Esc closes (Cancel). Enter should only trigger the action for the button with focus (so default focus on Cancel prevents accidental revoke).

jess: I'll update Figma with expanded copy + last-used + scopes + deletion date.

mike: I'll add focus behavior and toast to FLOW-238.

tamir: I'll add aria props and sample code to the PR.

design-bot: Staging preview with modal copy landed — preview link: /staging/keys (deploy in ~15m).

elaine: ok closing — ship soft revoke 7d, expanded copy, focus-on-cancel, undo toast. Ping if anything changes.
